member.name: T:Durable.MySql.MariaDbDialect
member.summary: MariaDB dialect (MariaDB 10.11+; tested on 11.4 LTS). Differences from : upserts use VALUES(column) (MariaDB has no row alias), empty-string tests use CHAR_LENGTH (MariaDB collations pad trailing spaces), ordinal matching uses the NO PAD binary collation utf8mb4_nopad_bin, LEAD/LAG defaults are emulated (MariaDB has no default argument), and JSON columns (a LONGTEXT alias) introspect as longtext. Thread safety: immutable; safe to share.

member.summary: Gets the shared default instance.

member.name: T:Durable.MySql.MySqlDataTypeConverter
member.summary: MySQL value conversion. MySqlConnector handles most types natively; values are stored as UTC DATETIME values because MySQL has no offset-aware type, GUIDs are stored as 36-character strings, and values are stored as BIGINT ticks so durations beyond MySQL's TIME range round-trip. Thread safety: stateless; safe for concurrent use.
